asset.name: Hollow Delve cave landscape
asset.visual_description:
A broad natural cavern opens around an old haulage path cut into damp limestone.
Water darkens the blue-grey rock beneath blunt stalactites. Uneven timber
supports and rusted iron brackets mark the excavated sections; their feet sit
on stacks of stone shims. Two small oil lamps cast dull amber pools across the
worn rock. Thin shelves of pale fungus follow a seepage line on the rear wall.
Beyond the path, overlapping rock ledges fall away into a quiet, dark hollow.
Loose gravel and a narrow drainage channel collect at the edge of the raised
walking shelf, leaving its middle clear.
